WITH ex AS (
  SELECT e.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.valid_from, m.valid_to
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT ex.member_id) AS dist_members,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ex.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h) THEN ex.member_id END) AS overlap_holdout,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT marketing_consent THEN ex.member_id END) AS no_consent_members,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) AS unmatched,
  min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered) AS delivered_rows
FROM ex

WITH camp AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
member_lines AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
spend AS (
  SELECT l.member_id, SUM(l.net_amount) AS spend
  FROM member_lines l, camp c
  WHERE l.business_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
  GROUP BY 1
),
grp AS (
  SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS grp FROM targeted
  UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
)
SELECT g.grp, count(DISTINCT g.member_id) AS members, count(sp.member_id) AS buyers, SUM(COALESCE(sp.spend,0)) AS total, SUM(COALESCE(sp.spend,0))/count(DISTINCT g.member_id) AS avg_spend
FROM grp g LEFT JOIN spend sp ON sp.member_id = g.member_id
GROUP BY 1

SELECT count(*) filter (where h.member_id is not null) holdout_ids, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.member_id IS NULL) missing_in_dim
FROM campaign_holdout h LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM dim_member) m ON m.member_id=h.member_id WHERE h.campaign_id=15

WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM stg_campaign_contact_load e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
f AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) stg_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM f) fact_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM f)) in_stg_not_fact,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM h)) stg_overlap_holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=15) stg_rows

 count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT m.marketing_consent) no_consent
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15

WITH grp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id, 'targeted' g FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15
  UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT member_id, 'holdout' FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
wd AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) dd FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected'))
SELECT g.g, s.store_id=900 AS is_web, (s.store_id=999) AS s999, (p.category='ZZ Test') AS test, f.staff_purchase_flag,
  (COALESCE(w.dd, f.sale_date) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07') AS in_window_dispatch_dating,
  (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07') AS in_window_sale_date,
  count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key JOIN grp g ON g.member_id=m.member_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-10' AND DATE '2025-12-20'
GROUP BY ALL HAVING in_window_dispatch_dating OR in_window_sale_date ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH camp AS (SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 15),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
spend AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS spend
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  CROSS JOIN camp c
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
  GROUP BY 1),
t AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend,0)) a, count(*) n FROM targeted g LEFT JOIN spend sp ON sp.member_id = g.member_id),
h AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(sp.spend,0)) a, count(*) n FROM holdout g LEFT JOIN spend sp ON sp.member_id = g.member_id)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name, t.n AS targeted_members, h.n AS holdout_members,
  ROUND(t.a,2) AS avg_spend_targeted, ROUND(h.a,2) AS avg_spend_holdout, ROUND(t.a - h.a,2) AS uplift_eur
FROM t, h
